source: Public subset of the programme facts v5.1 (November 2026), with review corrections. Estimates and targets, not completed milestones or supplier quotations. Contains no financing or offering terms.
product: Spacecraft inference software and GPU compute in orbit: a ready-made space-rated flight computer hosted on a partner spacecraft first, followed by separately financed solar compute nodes

firstMission.name: SI-P1 first flight
firstMission.flightComputer: Space-rated NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin unit, bought ready-made
firstMission.carrier: Hosted payload on a partner spacecraft
firstMission.fallback: Own Thor-class payload for a 2028 flight if no 2027 slot is contracted

plan.basePlanScope: Team, software, bench tests on the engineering unit, the flight computer, hosting and launch, operations in orbit and company costs

module1.description: First 20 kW compute module, ideally hosted on a partner's high-power satellite

node1.description: First own satellite, built from five 20 kW compute modules

futureArchitectures.longTermAmbition: 1 GW by 2035, built in stages only when launch and satellite costs cross our thresholds
